Remove the connecting plugs, 
then draw out the main body.
Clean the relay using a spray.

Clean contacts of the relay using a
contact burnisher.

Connect relay coil terminals ( 
3 , 4 ) to multi-amp output.

Connect relay terminals ( 7 , 8

Adjusting the Multi-amp at 200% current
tap and record the tripping time.

Repeat the step no. 8 at 300% , 
400% current tap.

Connect the relay terminals 
again and connect DC power supply.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually
bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
Solid
state over current relay type ITE-51E to protect 6.3kv motors.
The first draft imitated by 
eng. Ahmed EL-Husany, tested by eng. Tarek EL-kafafy, accepted by general director 
eng. Nady Mosaed, and approved by
eng. Mohamed EL-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra EL-Kheima PS.
This document revised by
eng.Nageh Soliman Shousha, CEPC quality control director, and certified by
eng. Afaf Ebrahim el Dib: CEPC 
head sector of inspection and quality control
& MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precaution
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category
Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.
Safety
 fence caution marks surrounding the work area.
Equipment which relay protect is isolated.
Disconnect the DC power supply.
Tools and Equipment
AC
 multi-amp model MS-2-E
Timer
 model MCS-5N.
Avometer, DC
 power supply 125 V.
Spray, Burnisher.
Work to be carried out
Remove the cover.
Remove the connecting plugs, 
then draw out the main body.
Clean the relay using a spray.
Clean contacts of the relay using a
contact burnisher.
Connect relay coil terminals ( 
3 , 4 ) to multi-amp output.
Connect relay terminals ( 7 , 8 
) to DC power supply.
Connect relay terminals (7 , 
12) to timer.
Adjusting the Multi-amp at 200% current
tap and record the tripping time.
Repeat the step no. 8 at 300% , 
400% current tap.
Connect the relay terminals 
again and connect DC power supply.
